overview_description.description: Engineers and Architects end up redesigning hundreds of details a year just because they are unable to search through all their past details. Pirros allows them to effectively manage and search all their past project details so that they can find reasonable starting points rather than starting from scratch.

about_short_description.short_description: Pirros is a detail management system for architects and engineers.

product.name: Pirros Detail Management System
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing, searching, organizing, and integrating architectural and engineering details into Revit projects.

product.name: Search & Filter Feature
product.description: A tool within Pirros that enables users to locate architectural and engineering details quickly using keywords and metadata filters.

product.name: Revit Integration
product.description: Integration that allows users to move details between Pirros and Autodesk Revit for a streamlined design workflow.

product.name: Organize & Collaborate Tools
product.description: Features that allow users to group, share, categorize, and manage architectural and engineering details within teams.

product.name: Data Tracking & Detail Vetting
product.description: Functionality to monitor detail usage and assist in vetting and approving details for inclusion in the firm’s library.
